title: Neki – Sharded Postgres
summary: PlanetScale introduced Neki, a sharding solution designed to enable horizontal scaling of PostgreSQL databases. The project addresses the challenge of scaling Postgres beyond single-node limitations while maintaining compatibility with the PostgreSQL ecosystem.
problem_solved: Solves the horizontal scaling limitation of PostgreSQL when vertical scaling reaches its ceiling.
why_valuable: Enables developers to scale PostgreSQL workloads horizontally while maintaining familiar Postgres syntax and tooling, avoiding the need to migrate to entirely different distributed databases.
